title: The Exodar
body: The Exodar was never meant to be a city. It was a dimensional ship, a satellite of Tempest Keep, the naaru's fortress in the Netherstorm of Outland, and Prophet Velen led the draenei who seized it to flee to Azeroth. It crashed on Azuremyst, and its largest surviving section is now their capital. At its heart the round Seat of the Naaru shelters the naaru O'ros, and from it branch the Crystal Hall of the shaman, the Vault of Lights and the Trader's Tier.

title: The Crystal Hall
body: The Crystal Hall, the Exodar's northern wing, is built around a shining pool known as the Light Blessed Waters, and it belongs to the shaman. Farseer Nobundo teaches here, asking his pupils to respect the elements of this world and the balance its spirits keep. Shamanism is only now being relearned among the draenei, and many still distrust it, or the Broken who teach it.

title: The Vault of Lights
body: The Vault of Lights, the Exodar's western wing, is a house of the Light and of learning, where paladins, priests and mages train. Holographic emitters run a museum of the Burning Legion, naming each servant of the enemy for passing tour groups, down to the eredar, once the draenei's own kinsmen. Prophet Velen keeps to the upper platform under the watch of his guards, the Shield of Velen.

title: Prophet Velen
body: Prophet Velen leads the draenei. On Argus he ruled the eredar beside Kil'jaeden and Archimonde, and when Sargeras offered them power, a vision showed Velen the price: worlds destroyed and his people turned to demons. He fled with those who would follow, and the Legion has hunted them ever since. Now, as his people seek this world's help, he reminds them that they must also learn to live peaceably among its peoples.
